title: femto.style divergence registry file
description: Every file in tests/divergences/ except this one is a JSON array of entries. A difference between side A (the oracle) and side B passes only if at least one entry matches it. Patterns: omitted or "*" matches anything, "/regex/flags" is a regular expression (flags i, m, s, u; in route patterns it must start with ^), null (a and b only) matches an absent value (an attribute or element missing on that side), and any other string matches exactly (style values compare with the harness color tolerance: 1/255 per channel, 0.004 alpha). Self comparisons (criterion 1) apply skipped-check entries only. Every entry must be specific, judged on what it would actually match (tests/harness/registry.py evaluates its selector, path and route scope on the oracle's captured DOMs, the fixture site under every control, and dist/ once built, its path patterns with JavaScript's RegExp as differ.js applies them): every element or head entry, route-scoped or not, reaches at most 25% of the compared elements (head: head keys) of any one document past 4 of them, and with the other entries of its kind at most 50%; one that names more than 3 routes (or none) also reaches at most 5% (head: 10%) of a complete site's compared elements over the routes in its scope, and those entries together at most 25%; all entries of a kind share a budget of 25% of each complete site (the oracle; a dist build once it holds every kept route); at most 3 routes without a reference document, in one entry or in the whole registry; a status entry names at most 3 routes; a skipped-check entry names one or two browsers and at most 2 of the known checks. A rejected entry is not applied. In every cell differ.js applies the per-document limits again on the live documents (an entry over them is a harness error and is not applied there), and the registered records may cover at most 25% of either document. tests/README.md (Divergence registry) documents matching in full.

kind.description: structure: an element on one side only, or another tag where the alignment pairs two elements (a: side A's tag or null, b: side B's). attribute: an attribute value or presence (property: the attribute name). text: an element's own text. style: a computed longhand of an element or one of its pseudo-elements. head: the title, a <meta>, a non-stylesheet <link>, <base> or a data-block <script> (application/ld+json, ...) of the document (path: the head key such as title, meta[name=description], meta[property=og:url], link[rel=canonical], base, script[type=application/ld+json]; property: text, content, href, a JSON leaf such as $.version, ...). status: the route's final document status and path ("200 /docs"). skipped-check: a check a browser cannot run (media:dark, pseudo:::backdrop, ...).

selector.description: Element kinds: a CSS selector the element must match, evaluated on side B, or on side A when side B has no element at that path. "*" for any (then its path must be narrow: no selector reaches more than 25% of a document, whatever routes it names). No pseudo-elements (the pseudo field names them).

path.description: Element kinds: the record's tree path (html > body:0 > main:1 > section:0, "#shadow" for a shadow root's children), exact, "*" or /regex/. head: the head key (title, meta[name=description], link[rel=canonical], script[type=application/ld+json]; #2 for a repeat), exact or /regex/. status: the route, exact, "*" or a regex that starts with ^ (/^\/docs\/forms/), since every route starts with a slash.

pseudo.description: style only: "" for the element itself, "::before", "::after", "::marker", "::placeholder", "::file-selector-button", "::backdrop", "*" or /regex/. Omitted means any.

property.description: style: the longhand; attribute: the attribute name; head: the compared value (text for the title, else the attribute name, a JSON leaf of a data block such as $.version or $.author.name, (text) for a data block that is not JSON, or (element) for an element with no other attribute). Exact, "*" or /regex/. Required for all three.

a.description: Side A's value (the oracle): exact, "*", /regex/, or null for absent.

b.description: Side B's value: exact, "*", /regex/, or null for absent.

check.description: skipped-check: the check name (media:dark, media:light, pseudo:::backdrop, ...), exact or /regex/.

where.description: Optional filters; every listed key must match the comparison cell.

browsers.description: Required for skipped-check entries, with one or two browsers: a browser limit belongs to the browser that has it.

routes.description: Route paths, exact (/docs/forms/input), or a regular expression that starts with ^ (/^\/docs\/forms/): a route starts with a slash itself, so /docs/forms/input is always the route; "*" or any other item that does not start with a slash is a registry error, never a wildcard. At most 3 routes make an entry route-scoped: exempt from the site shares, never from the per-document limits (a route scope narrows where an entry applies, not how much of a page it may cover) or from its kind's budget; a regular expression counts the known routes it matches, and more than 3 routes without a reference document, in one entry or in the whole registry, is an error.

comparisons.description: self or pages. Only skipped-check entries may name self: no element, head or status entry applies to a self comparison.

category.description: PLAN.md, Divergence categories. dropped-route: a link, menu item or footer item for a Decision 5 route. femto-divergence: one of femto's own registered differences from Pico 2.1.1. merge-layout: an intended one-page change. id-rename: a Decision 13 rename. oracle-bug: an oracle bug the conversion fixes naturally. highlight: a difference from Prism's version or grammars. asset-path: a hashed Remix build URL (/build/_assets/<name>-<HASH>.<ext>) the conversion rewrites to its stable /assets/ path, and nothing else. browser-limit: as in femto (every skipped check).

reason.description: Why the difference is intended (acceptance criterion 3).
